## Design

### 2026-10-28: ### SMC is done

**1.75h**

### SMC is done

Okay, so essentially I spent a bit of time just writing all of our parts and figuring out what we need. So we decided I'm going to use the ESP32C3.0. The same one I used for my MDI keyboard, I just chose it because it was relatively cheap, had a lot of GPIO and also had lots of processing power for the screen.

Then I also went with a TFT 1.8 inch display, so that's fun. So I wired all of them up and a rotator encoder, as well as a simple audio jack. I haven't used any of these parts before, other than the encoder and ESP32, so it was pretty new to me.

And the DF player mini was definitely hard to get because there wasn't a dedicated schematic so I had to kind of make my own Here's some images.

### 2026-10-29: ### Wiring

**1.5h**

### Wiring

So after a bit of time of the PCB was finalized Essentially all of the traces were done So first I started off with having a little Plan for I want to place everything I want the screen and the rotator reencoder right below it So I can easily change the song and then below that I want the audio jack.

Okay, so I was able to fit everything there and route it up on the second try. The first try, I ran into some problems, but I was able to solve them when I had to restart everything.

So here are some images.

### 2026-10-30: ### PCB Done and CAD

**1.5h**

### PCB Done and CAD

Okay, so I added screw holes to the PCB, rounded the corners, and in general just finished it up, made sure all the routes were good. Then I started catting. I made a little case for it, which has the screw holes, holes for the charger, and also a hole for like the actual audio jack.

I need to make the top and the little knob for the turn thing. But that's tomorrow's job.
